methodology: Warm in-process calls timed by the site matrix harnesses; median per call after symmetric 1.5×IQR outlier filtering, raw samples and exclusions retained. Every timed checksum and the printed output are verified against the instruction engine, and the zx2native ELF of each kernel is run once and checked the same way. ZX native times the bundle translated to machine code when it is instantiated, in the same host as C and the engine. Process startup and compilation are excluded for every target. The Wasm module charges no step budget. Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core, chosen again before each attempt once its other hyperthread has settled, and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
